answer: The tide edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 23 clones produces a signature the violet analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the mesa settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
